purpose: Non-admission original-source discovery for historical event-based tropical cyclone wind footprint challenges and separately aggregated CLIMADA-on-HDX hazard exports. The sources have different physical/event semantics and are not approved model inputs, downloads, insurer exposures or loss records.

entries.name: Willis Research Network global historical tropical cyclone wind footprints (Figshare collection v1)
entries.provider: Willis Research Network / James Done and coauthors via Figshare
entries.spatial_scope: Global landfalling and selected near-miss tropical cyclones with regional historical-coverage differences
entries.temporal_scope: Figshare collection version 1 published 2022-02-17; historical storms through 2019; basin start dates depend on available input track and radius-of-maximum-wind observations
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 1,046 modelled historical cyclone footprints; storm-lifetime maximum one-minute-average 10-m sustained wind in m/s on lat/lon grids at approximately 3 km globally and 4 km for Caribbean and US regions; source describes 17 regional gzipped TAR archives nested inside a parent TAR Figshare original public article 19178426 lists one parent TAR named WRN_TC_footprint_dataset.tar, 504,492,032 bytes; file id 34074575.
entries.note: Original Figshare collection DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.5843453.v1 describes modelled Willoughby/Kepert-Wang wind fields informed by historical Extended Best Track/JTWC and IBTrACS lineage, including a 1.225 urban wind-speed adjustment. A footprint is a lifetime peak sustained wind envelope, NOT a gust, time-series event track, measured wind observation, insured loss, complete set of cyclones or stochastic annual-frequency catalogue. Missing storms can result from missing rmax observations. Collection-level metadata does not establish each original item/asset licence, stable checksum, event naming convention, file count, or safe commercial reuse. No source file, metadata API response, model-input artefact or byte hash was acquired. Original full-dataset parent-TAR is the distinct Figshare dataset article DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.19178426.v1 (collection DOI is not itself the archived data file). The underlying 2020 method paper describes 714 modeled storms, while this later 2022 collection states 1,046: preserve collection/release vintage, do not merge or silently equate the counts. Figshare public article metadata checked 2026-11-04: status public, version 1, dataset item licence CC BY 4.0, declared/computed-provider MD5 95c7629cf88f5587a6193c9901abaa89. MD5 is publisher metadata only, NOT independently observed file-byte integrity; per-original asset provenance/scientific admission remains unreviewed.

entries.name: ETH CLIMADA tropical cyclone country and admin-level hazard CSV exports on HDX
entries.provider: ETH Zurich Weather and Climate Risks / UN OCHA HDX exporter
entries.spatial_scope: Selected humanitarian-response countries with country 150-arcsecond raster-like point grids and administrative summaries; not uniformly global building-level coverage
entries.temporal_scope: HDX tropical-cyclone product catalogued with historical coverage 1980-01-02 through 2020-12-25; HDX page last modified 2025-09-06; actual temporal meaning is resource and indicator specific
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 35 reported HDX resources, typically about 4 km at the equator; country-level gridded CSV, admin1 summary CSV, and where available admin-level event-date time-series summary, with second-row HXL tags. Values and aggregation semantics (sum/max) differ by indicator and resource
entries.note: Official HDX product declares CC BY 4.0, but exact resource and upstream dataset rights, file vintage and attribution must be checked. OCHA exporter source at https://github.com/OCHA-DAP/hdx-scraper-climada documents CSV fields and HXL tag row, and its build uses a private UNMAP boundary dataset; do not copy or assume rights in those upstream boundaries. The CSV export may contain grids, admin summaries or event_date values but no validated globally unique event IDs, common stochastic event catalogue, annual frequency or insured-loss mapping. Data last dated 2020 cannot represent current hazard monitoring. No original HDX CSV bytes, file checksums or live retrieval response were acquired. HDX original CKAN package metadata checked 2026-11-04, package UUID f02bb601-9314-4162-9ebd-e1d18cdc2739, licence_id cc-by, 35 declared resources, last_modified 2025-09-06T08:28:47.833967. Resource admin1-summaries-tropical-cyclone.csv has metadata UUID d7ec31cc-becd-4e83-864d-705e60bc50a9 and reported size 24,396 bytes; direct CSV fetch was NOT verified, so header/HXL actual bytes are not checked.
